name: party-game
description: Real-time drawing and guessing party game (Gartic-like) where AI picks the word, judges guesses and gives hints

roomId.description: Room identifier for the game. Null = user enters a room name in the lobby.

_discovery.describe: Real-time drawing/guessing party game (Gartic-like) built on the existing realtime building blocks (useDistributedState + partyStore + server-authoritative backend). Players join a room, take turns drawing a secret word, others guess, and AI participates as word-picker (LLM with word-bank fallback), judge and hint-giver. No new infrastructure: 3 distributed state branches (game/strokes/guesses) over Redis Pub/Sub.
use_cases: Play a drawing/guessing party game with friends in a room
AI picks the secret word and validates guesses in realtime
AI gives progressive hints after wrong guesses
